get.description: Row counts for every module the user may view. Modules the user cannot view are left out.
Reports `ok` (200) when the database and the cache answer, otherwise `degraded` (503).
Values come from the LOCALE_DEFAULT, LOCALE_FALLBACK and LOCALE_SUPPORTED env vars.

post.description:
Revokes the current access token and its refresh tokens. The browser session on the
login page is ended separately by visiting `/logout`.

get.description:
The authenticated user with role and permission names. The superadmin
gets every permission name.

patch.description:
`name`, and/or `password` with `current_password` and `password_confirmation`. Other sessions are signed out
when the password changes. Returns the same body as `GET /me`.

get.description: The navigation tree filtered by the user's permissions.
Unrevoked, unexpired access tokens, newest first; `current` marks the one making this request.

put.description: `ids` is the new order of one set of siblings; entries keep their parent. Ids from different parents are rejected.

get.description: The whole tree, unfiltered, flattened depth-first (`depth` 0 = top level) in display order.

patch.summary: Update a menu entry's title or icon

get.description: Every permission name (`<module>.<action>`), for the role matrix. The route is gated by `roles.view`.
Every role except the superadmin, with its permission names. Not paginated.

put.description: `permissions` replaces the role's permission names. A permission you do not hold yourself is rejected (422).

get.description: The single settings record, for the site header, footer and metadata. No authentication.
The single settings record (edit-only: there is no create or delete).

put.description: Partial update; only the fields sent are changed.

post.description: Multipart field `image` (jpeg, png or webp). Replaces the current logo.
Multipart field `image` (ico, jpeg, png or webp), ideally square. Replaces the current favicon.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

put.description: A blank password keeps the current one. `roles` replaces the user's roles (the superadmin role is never touched here).

get.description: Unrevoked, unexpired access tokens, newest first.

patch.description:
`status` is `active` or `suspended`. Suspending signs the user out everywhere and blocks sign-in. You cannot
suspend yourself, and a superadmin is never suspended.

depth.description: Set by MenuController::index: rows come depth-first, so the UI can indent without rebuilding the tree.

StoreSettingImageRequest.description: Logo and favicon uploads: multipart field `image` (the favicon may also be an .ico).
StoreSettingImageRequest.title: StoreSettingImageRequest

roles.description: The superadmin role is not assignable here, so it is left out of the editable list.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
